name: IJM Corporation Berhad
summary: IJM Corporation Berhad operates as a construction business in Malaysia, India, and the United Kingdom. It operates through Construction, Property Development, Manufacturing and Quarrying, Infrastructure  Tollway, and Infrastructure - Port segments. The company offers civil engineering works; commercial and cultural complexes, including shopping malls and other public buildings; restoration and refurbishment works for local authorities and commercial property owners; highways, roads, and bridges; water supply projects, gas turbine facilities, and hydroelectric power stations; and railways and metro systems.
